subject: Pricing page CTA — quick demo & pricing follow-up
messages:
From: Sam Ortega <sam.ortega@cloudharbor.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interested in Redwood Inference — pricing questions & demo

Hi Jasmine,

I filled out the pricing form earlier today — we’re evaluating inference platforms for a pilot (budget allocated for Q4). Would love a short demo to see how Redwood handles multi-tenant routing and cost controls.

Primary questions:
- Can you support per-customer isolation on dedicated pools?
- Typical latency for 512-token responses on an A100-backed pool?
- Do you have a pricing summary for committed vs on-demand?

We’re in Pacific time (SF). I’m available tomorrow afternoon. Attaching a short note from procurement with scope.

Thanks,
Sam Ortega
Director of Engineering, CloudHarbor
procurement@cloudharbor.com
